# Work Packages: Typed Options Migration

**Inputs**: Design documents from `kitty-specs/001-typed-options-migration/`
**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (user stories), data-model.md

**Tests**: Existing tests must not be modified (FR-007). New tests for Options validation are expected.

**Organization**: Fine-grained subtasks (`Txxx`) roll up into work packages (`WPxx`). Each work package must be independently deliverable and testable.

**Prompt Files**: Each work package references a matching prompt file in `kitty-specs/001-typed-options-migration/tasks/` generated by `/spec-kitty.tasks`.

---

## Work Package WP01: Re-verify Base Class Infrastructure (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Confirm that existing base class infrastructure (`ArrayOptions`, `Field::constructFromOptions`, `Field::postHydrate`, `FieldListOptions::hydrateObject`) is correctly wired and all existing tests pass as a baseline.
**Independent Test**: Full PHPUnit suite passes. `FieldList` can be constructed via `FieldListOptions` with the three-phase lifecycle.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP01-reverify-base-infrastructure.md`
**Estimated size**: ~250 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T001 Audit `ArrayOptions` base class for `validate()` and abstract `hydrateObject()` signatures
- [ ] T002 Audit `Field::constructFromOptions`, `Field::collectFieldFlags`, `Field::postHydrate` wiring
- [ ] T003 Audit `FieldListOptions::hydrateObject` and `FieldList::postHydrate` implementation
- [ ] T004 Run full test suite to confirm baseline — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- Read-only audit phase. No code changes expected unless bugs found.
- Document any issues discovered for follow-up in subsequent WPs.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T001, T002, T003 can be audited in parallel.

### Dependencies
- None (starting package).

### Risks & Mitigations
- If `hydrateObject` is abstract and existing Options classes don't implement it, tests will fatal. Mitigate by running tests early to identify scope.

---

## Work Package WP02: Wire Existing Field Options — Tier 1 (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Add `hydrateObject()` to `FieldOptions`, `SelectFieldOptions`, `DateTimeFieldOptions`. Update `SelectField` and `DateTimeField` constructors to accept typed options. Add `postHydrate()` overrides.
**Independent Test**: Construct `SelectField` and `DateTimeField` via typed Options objects; existing tests still pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP02-wire-field-options-tier1.md`
**Estimated size**: ~400 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T005 Implement `FieldOptions::hydrateObject()` — pure property assignment for label, description, validators, filters, id, default, render_kw
- [ ] T006 Implement `SelectFieldOptions::hydrateObject()` — choices, coerce. Add `SelectField::postHydrate()` for default Select widget and identity coerce
- [ ] T007 Implement `DateTimeFieldOptions::hydrateObject()` — format. Add `DateTimeField::postHydrate()` for strftime-to-Carbon conversion and default TextInput
- [ ] T008 Update `SelectField` and `DateTimeField` constructors to accept `array|XOptions` union type
- [ ] T009 Run full test suite — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- `FieldOptions::hydrateObject()` is the foundation — all other field Options inherit from it.
- Process in order: FieldOptions first, then SelectField, then DateTime.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T006 and T007 can proceed in parallel after T005 completes.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01.

### Risks & Mitigations
- `FieldOptions::hydrateObject()` is used by all fields — must be correct before proceeding.

---

## Work Package WP03: Wire Validator Base and Options — Tier 1 (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Add `constructFromOptions` + `postHydrate` hook to `Validator` base class. Implement `validate()` and `hydrateObject()` on all 9 existing validator Options classes. Update validator constructors.
**Independent Test**: Construct each validator via typed Options; existing validator tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP03-wire-validator-options-tier1.md`
**Estimated size**: ~500 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T010 Add `constructFromOptions` and `postHydrate` hook to `Validator` base class, mirroring `Field`
- [ ] T011 Implement `validate()` and `hydrateObject()` for `LengthOptions` (min/max guards) and `NumberRangeOptions`
- [ ] T012 [P] Implement `validate()` and `hydrateObject()` for `AnyOfOptions` (values array, formatter callable), `OptionalOptions` (strip_whitespace)
- [ ] T013 [P] Implement `validate()` and `hydrateObject()` for `RegexpOptions` (valid regex), `UUIDOptions` (inherits + default pattern), `IPAddressOptions` (ip_type flags)
- [ ] T014 [P] Implement `validate()` and `hydrateObject()` for `EqualToOptions` (fieldname present), `RequiredIfOptions` (fieldname present)
- [ ] T015 Update all 9 validator constructors to accept `array|XOptions` union type
- [ ] T016 Run full test suite — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- T010 (Validator base) must complete first. Then T011–T014 can proceed in parallel.
- T015 updates constructors after all Options classes have `hydrateObject()`.
- Each validator's `validate()` should throw `TypeError` for missing required fields.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T012, T013, T014 are independent (different files).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (ArrayOptions base verified).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Abstract `hydrateObject()` means all 9 classes must be implemented before tests run. Batch in one WP to avoid partial-implementation fatals.

---

## Work Package WP04: Leaf Field postHydrate — Core Fields (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Add `postHydrate()` override to core leaf fields that reuse `FieldOptions`. Each sets its default widget. No new Options classes.
**Independent Test**: Each field constructed via `FieldOptions` gets its correct default widget via `postHydrate()`. Existing tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP04-leaf-field-posthydrate-core.md`
**Estimated size**: ~350 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T017 [P] Add `postHydrate()` to `StringField` (TextInput), `IntegerField` (TextInput), `FloatField` (TextInput), `DecimalField` (inherits FloatField)
- [ ] T018 [P] Add `postHydrate()` to `BooleanField` (CheckboxInput), `SelectFieldBase` (Option widget), `SelectMultipleField` (Select multiple:true), `RadioField` (ListWidget + RadioInput)
- [ ] T019 [P] Add `postHydrate()` to `PasswordField` (PasswordInput), `FileField` (FileInput), `HiddenField` (HiddenInput), `TextAreaField` (TextArea), `SubmitField` (SubmitInput)
- [ ] T020 Run full test suite — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- Each `postHydrate()` is a 3–5 line method that sets `$this->widget` if not already set.
- Pattern: `if ($this->widget === null) { $this->widget = new XWidget(); }`
- Must check that the array path also converges on `postHydrate()`.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T017, T018, T019 are fully parallel (different files).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02 (FieldOptions::hydrateObject must exist).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Existing constructors may already set widgets inline. Must move that logic to `postHydrate()` and ensure the array path calls it too.

## Work Package WP05: Leaf Field postHydrate — HTML5 Fields (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Add `postHydrate()` override to HTML5 leaf fields. No new Options classes.
**Independent Test**: Each HTML5 field gets its correct default widget. Existing tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP05-leaf-field-posthydrate-html5.md`
**Estimated size**: ~250 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T021 [P] Add `postHydrate()` to `EmailField` (EmailInput), `URLField` (URLInput), `TelField` (TelInput), `SearchField` (SearchInput)
- [ ] T022 [P] Add `postHydrate()` to `DateTimeLocalField` (DateTimeLocalInput), Range fields (RangeInput)
- [ ] T023 Run full test suite — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- Same pattern as WP04 but for HTML5 field subclasses.
- These fields are simpler — most just set a single widget.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T021 and T022 are fully parallel.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02 (FieldOptions::hydrateObject).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Low risk — simple widget assignments.

## Work Package WP06: New Options Classes — Widgets, FormField, CSRF (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Create all new Options classes: 6 Widget Options, `FormFieldOptions`, `CSRFTokenFieldOptions`. Wire `Widget` base with `constructFromOptions` + `postHydrate` hook. Update constructors.
**Independent Test**: Construct widgets, FormField, and CSRFTokenField via typed Options. Existing tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP06-new-options-widgets-formfield-csrf.md`
**Estimated size**: ~500 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T024 Add `constructFromOptions` and `postHydrate` hook to `Widget` base class
- [ ] T025 [P] Create `InputOptions`, `PasswordInputOptions` in `src/Widgets/Options/`. Wire `Input` and `PasswordInput` constructors.
- [ ] T026 [P] Create `ListWidgetOptions`, `TableWidgetOptions` in `src/Widgets/Options/`. Wire constructors.
- [ ] T027 [P] Create `NumberInputOptions`, `RangeInputOptions` in `src/Widgets/Options/`. Wire constructors.
- [ ] T028 Create `FormFieldOptions` in `src/Fields/Options/`. Implement `validate()` (form_class required, no filters/validators), `hydrateObject()`. Update `FormField` constructor. Add `FormField::postHydrate()` for default TableWidget.
- [ ] T029 Create `CSRFTokenFieldOptions` in `src/CSRF/Options/`. Implement `validate()`, `hydrateObject()`. Update `CSRFTokenField` constructor.
- [ ] T030 Run full test suite — zero failures

### Implementation Notes
- T024 (Widget base) must complete first.
- Widget Options are simple: 1–3 typed properties each.
- `FormFieldOptions` has validation: form_class required, no filters, no validators.
- `CSRFTokenFieldOptions` validates csrf_impl present and valid.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T025, T026, T027 are fully parallel after T024.
- T028 and T029 are independent of widget work.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (ArrayOptions base), WP02 (FieldOptions for FormField).

### Risks & Mitigations
- New directory creation (`src/Widgets/Options/`, `src/CSRF/Options/`) — ensure PSR-4 autoloading configured in `composer.json`.

## Work Package WP07: FormOptions and Deprecation (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Create `FormOptions`, add `constructFromOptions` to `Form`, and add `@deprecated` annotations to all array-path branches across all migrated classes.
**Independent Test**: `Form` can be constructed via `FormOptions`. All array paths annotated `@deprecated`. Full test suite passes. PHPStan clean.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP07-form-options-and-deprecation.md`
**Estimated size**: ~350 lines

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T031 Create `FormOptions` in `src/Options/`. Implement `validate()`, `hydrateObject()` (normalize prefix). Add `Form::constructFromOptions`.
- [ ] T032 Update `Form` constructor to accept `array|FormOptions` union type
- [ ] T033 [P] Add `@deprecated` annotations to array-path branches in all Field constructors
- [ ] T034 [P] Add `@deprecated` annotations to array-path branches in all Validator constructors
- [ ] T035 [P] Add `@deprecated` annotations to array-path branches in all Widget constructors and Form constructor
- [ ] T036 Run full test suite + PHPStan — zero failures, no new errors

### Implementation Notes
- `Form` does not extend `Field` — needs its own `constructFromOptions` method.
- `FormOptions::hydrateObject()` normalizes prefix by appending '-'.
- Deprecation is mechanical: add `@deprecated Use XOptions parameter instead` to each array-path branch.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T033, T034, T035 are fully parallel (different class families).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02, WP03, WP04, WP05, WP06 (all Options implementations must be in place before deprecating array paths).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Deprecation annotations may trigger PHPStan notices if configuration tracks them. Verify PHPStan config.

---

## Dependency & Execution Summary

- **Sequence**: WP01 → WP02 → (WP03 || WP04 || WP05) → WP06 → WP07
- **Parallelization**: WP03, WP04, WP05 can run in parallel after WP02 completes. WP06 can start after WP01+WP02.
- **MVP Scope**: WP01 + WP02 + WP03 + WP04 + WP05 deliver the core migration. WP06 + WP07 complete it.
